reviews.title: Helpful but horrible
reviews.text: The very first time I was sent a link to a car on CARFAX, it opened automatically in my browser on my phone. The second time I went to open a link I was sent to a different car, it opened to the first link I was sent. The second time I tried to click on the more recent link it rerouted me to the App Store. After multiple times of being rerouted to the App Store, I downloaded the app. I got one day of cohesive use of the app, clicking on the links I was sent and quickly being taken to the correct car listing in the app, before I started being redirected to the App Store again. There is no update needed and I have downloaded the app. I do not understand what is wrong. It is extremely aggravating and for how far technology and app development has come, this does not seem like it should be happening for an app of a reputable company.
